title: DeFi Best Practices: Research and Guide for User-Friendly DApps

ms.promise:
・Conduct research on a minimum of 5 distinct DeFi Best Practices Topics. 
・Review and analyze scholarly papers or industry reports related to DeFi best practices. (For example documents from DeFi projects or articles of TradFi companies about DeFi topics).
・Compile the findings into a detailed PDF report.
ms.criteria:
・Ensure the research report covers a range of DeFi topics 
・The report must cover at least 3 distinct DeFi topics from the 5 researched. (The ones that turn out to be the most fitting ones within the research process).
・Each topic should be discussed in a separate section of the report to ensure clear organization and comprehensiveness.
ms.report:
Hi, 
accessible via this link I have attached the Publication of the Research Findings for Milestone 1. 

Best regards!
Link: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ird0fsVZMCLZirt88UGQ5Y7nII97OAcf/view?usp=sharing

ms.promise: ・Develop a comprehensive Best Practice Guide based on the findings from the Research Report.
ms.criteria:
・The Best Practice Guide must address all the topics covered in the Research Report. 
・Each topic should be represented in a dedicated section within the guide.

・Each section must include:

・Overview: A brief summary of the topic.
・Best Practices: Detailed best practices related to the topic.
・Examples: Real-world examples or case studies where applicable.
・Recommendations: Practical recommendations for implementation.

・The guide will be formatted as a PDF document.
